dropzones.name: Rhoon landing area (Rotterdam)
dropzones.coordinates_source: https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/7511157 and https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/7511246 (junction of Lageweg and Poelweg, Rhoon, via Nominatim; the landing field is at that corner per buijtenland-van-rhoon.nl)
dropzones.status_evidence: On the KNVvL paracentra list (checked 2026-11-14); Buijtenland van Rhoon agenda lists a '60 jaar Skydive Rotterdam' exhibition on 13 December 2025 that names the Rhoon dropzone and a 2025 national title.

sources.what: KNVvL parachuting section list of the eight Dutch paracentra with their own dropzone (linked from knvvl.nl/parachutespringen/je-eerste-sprong)
operator site: aircraft takes off from Rotterdam The Hague Airport, tandems land on the dropzone in Rhoon
area cooperative page: since 2020 the landing site is in the corner of Lageweg and Poelweg (Buijtenland van Rhoon); Cessna Caravan from Rotterdam Airport
event page, 13 December 2025: club has its dropzone in the Buijtenland van Rhoon

dropzones.note: Coordinates are the Lageweg/Poelweg road junction, not a surveyed landing area; the field lies at that corner (accuracy about 100–200 m). The aircraft departs from Rotterdam The Hague Airport (EHRD), about 11 km north.
